topic: SpeedRunner public gh-pages artifact surface, existing visualization sidecars, and replay-admission provenance boundary

facts: The official repository exposes a gh-pages branch in addition to main.
The gh-pages public surface contains methods/, sleep_traces/, blog_evolution/, and other project-site artifacts.
The manifest publishes curated epoch-level cells for SpeedRunner, ASI, Voyager, OPO and a no-library baseline.
Observed cells include validation_score, selected episode_id, call/environment counts and a library.snapshot_path string that points back to an ignored internal runs/... codebook snapshot.
The observed manifest is Crafter-oriented; no replay-verification field or ScienceWorld Figure-12 run bundle was observed.
The epoch directory contains codebook.json, frames/, and sidecar.json.
The sidecar records a selected Crafter evaluation episode with seed, frame/primitive/LLM/environment counts, achievements, termination reason, per-call records and per-step records.

This is useful rollout/presentation provenance but it does not contain ASISleep candidate-skill transaction identity, replay test trajectories, replay pass/fail results, pre/candidate/post codebook digests, ScienceWorld environment artifact identity, or a Figure-12 condition/run identifier.
ASISleep holds proposed functions and scripted test trajectories in local _ASIState.
Replay executes a scripted test on a fresh problem_loader environment and returns only (success, used_new_helper, error).
The final transaction semantics are explicit: no-replay commits after static checks; replay mode reverts on missing/failed replay and commits only after all required replays pass.
ASISleep.update accepts unmatched keyword arguments through **_ and therefore does not consume the loop-provided sleep_trace_path.
WakeSleepLoop already allocates run_dir/oracle_trace/oracle_{batch_idx:04d}.json for every sleep phase and passes it as sleep_trace_path into SleepStrategy.update.
After sleep it persists a codebook snapshot and a generic checkpoint.
Therefore ASISleep replay-admission provenance can be emitted at an already allocated per-batch path without changing the wake/sleep decision interface or algorithmic commit/revert semantics.

scope_limited_findings.claim: The public SpeedRunner project site already demonstrates a practical split between compact curated manifests, selected episode sidecars, codebook snapshots and visual frames. This supports bounded operational/presentation artifacts with richer provenance sidecars, but the observed sidecars are rollout-telemetry artifacts rather than replay-admission proofs.
scope_limited_findings.scope: Observed gh-pages project artifacts only; not a claim about unpublished author run directories.

scope_limited_findings.claim: The minimal instrumentation route for exact ASI replay-admission provenance is reducible within the current public architecture: WakeSleepLoop already supplies a per-batch sleep_trace_path, while ASISleep currently discards it. Consuming that path and serializing transaction/replay evidence can preserve the existing commit/revert decisions.
scope_limited_findings.scope: Implementation-design conclusion from current public source bytes; does not claim the upstream project has adopted such instrumentation or that historical Figure-12 runs can be reconstructed retroactively.

scope_limited_findings.claim: The newly found gh-pages artifact surface narrows but does not close the Figure-12 provenance gap: it exposes Crafter ASI codebook/episode artifacts, yet no ScienceWorld replay-versus-no-replay numeric run bundle, task-3-only non-replay condition manifest, environment lock, or per-candidate replay transcript was observed.
scope_limited_findings.scope: Absence on the currently observed public main/release/gh-pages surfaces only.

protocol_relation.integration_requirement: Emit the existing replay-admission packet from ASISleep candidate-bearing terminal branches using the already-provided sleep_trace_path; do not conflate public Crafter rollout sidecar.json with a replay-admission sidecar.

next_actions: Persist an exact minimal ASISleep integration spec mapping live variables and terminal branches to skill_replay_admission_sidecar_v1 fields without changing algorithmic decisions.
Search the remaining public SpeedRunner project-site sources for ScienceWorld or Figure-12-specific artifacts; do not infer plot values from pixels.
Return to MemCompiler evaluated ScienceWorld memory/run-manifest binding after the SpeedRunner instrumentation leaf is durably specified.
